patterns.note: Extensive use of full-bleed, single-color, intricate illustrations as primary background elements, often spanning multiple sections or acting as a visual anchor.
A strong contrast between a very large, decorative serif font for hero and key section headings, and a clean, modern sans-serif for body text, navigation, and smaller labels.
A highly monochromatic color scheme dominated by a deep, vibrant blue and white, with subtle dark gray for body text, creating a bold and consistent brand identity.
The hero section features a large, intricate blue illustration that scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground text, creating a subtle parallax depth effect.
The header transforms from a transparent background with white text and logo to a solid white background with blue text and a resized, repositioned blue logo upon scroll, becoming sticky.
Key information sections are introduced with large, centered, uppercase headings, often followed by a brief descriptive paragraph, creating clear content hierarchy.

technique_notes: To rebuild the header, implement a sticky navigation bar that changes its background color, text color, and logo styling (size, position, color) based on scroll position, typically after a certain scroll threshold is met.

The parallax effect for the hero illustration can be achieved by setting the background image to scroll at a slower speed than the foreground content, often using CSS `background-attachment: fixed` or JavaScript-based scroll-speed manipulation.

The site uses a dominant brand blue for all illustrative elements, large headings, and key UI components, contrasted with white backgrounds and text, and a dark gray for body copy to maintain legibility.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very oversized, decorative serif hero heading (~4-5x body) with large, bold serif section headings (~2x body), and small, often uppercase sans-serif labels.
design_tokens.spacing: airy - generous vertical spacing between sections and within the hero, with balanced line-heights for readability.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the pervasive use of highly detailed, single-color, toile-like illustrations that serve as both decorative elements and structural backgrounds, giving the site a unique blend of historical elegance and modern impact.
